profile_text.body:
Ouster, Inc. is a for-profit public company headquartered in San Francisco, California, trading under the ticker OUST. Its website describes the company as a provider of digital lidar sensors for automation, drones, robotics, and smart cities. The site states that these sensors are intended to transform autonomy in vehicles, robotics, and smart cities.

The site includes a statement from Matt Reiland, Technical Director, Automation Innovation at Komatsu, who says that Ouster products developed through a partnership can withstand shock, vibration and temperature constraints while delivering enhanced range and spatial awareness necessary to operate in harsh mining environments. No additional product names are provided beyond the digital lidar sensor line.

The company files with the SEC under CIK 0001816581. No litigation cases are listed for it. Its legal exposure is concentrated in California, with 281 entries. No MCP servers are listed.
